display.purpose: The h1 that opens every page. One per page, max 15ch, balanced.

headline.purpose: Section headings in blocks, closes and articles.

directory-name.purpose: The destination name inside a directory row; used only there.

lead.purpose: The one plain line under a display heading, in secondary ink, max 44ch.

body.purpose: Prose and definitions, max 66ch in prose, 60ch in definitions.

small.purpose: Directory lines, form labels, help text, footer text, dates.

fonts.note: Draws a slashed zero by design with no unslashed alternate; the slashed zero is accepted everywhere.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition and the opening settle.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(14px) to none, 900ms, staggered 80ms
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the page opening, then directory rows (from 240ms) and the picture (1000ms, 260ms delay). Only without a reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: hover-fast
motion.purpose: Action background, nav link colour and background, field border.

motion.name: hover-panel
motion.purpose: Panel tone step on hover; the directory arrow moves 4px over 240ms.

components.name: The Action
components.description: The single blue action per screen, usually Get in touch.

components.name: Directory Row
components.description: The sign: one tone-step panel per destination, name, one line, arrow. Panels mean you can go here.

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Logo left, pill links in secondary ink, current page in ink at 650, then the small action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: #4a5059; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #111315; background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: #111315; font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5bff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, white field with a 1px line, blue focus.
components.html: Whichever you give us, that is how we will reply.

narrative.overview:
The site is a clear sign in a calm building: one statement, then a directory of where to go. Every page opens the same way (a large left-aligned statement, one plain line under it, at most one action) and then either points somewhere or says what it needs to in a two-column block. Nothing decorates; legibility, rhythm and the one blue action carry the whole system.

Density is low and the scale contrast is high: a display line up to 6rem against 1.125rem body, with generous section gaps. Light only, one ground, one ink and one grey tone step. The grey step has a single meaning: a panel you can go into. The site grows by registry entries (products, writing), never by new layouts.

The world rejects the split hero with a product shot, the row of feature cards, gradients, glass and resting shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One white ground, near-black ink, one grey tone step for panels.
SaveBytes blue only on the logo and the single action per screen.
One typeface (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next), five type roles plus the directory-name size.
Directory rows: bold name, one line, an arrow at the far edge; no outlines, no shadows.
At most one picture per page, set on a tone-step mat.
Dark footer that returns the "SaveBytes" name at full frame width.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: SaveBytes blue appears on the logo and on one action per screen. Nothing else is blue at rest: not links, not headings, not icons, not panels.

rules.name: The Light Only Rule
rules.body: There is no dark theme. The only dark surface is the footer.

rules.name: The Heading Stands Alone Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading: no eyebrow, no kicker, no numbered label. A section starts with its heading.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and stay flat on hover. State changes by tone, never by shadow, blur or glass.

rules.name: The Panel Means Go Rule
rules.body: A tone-step panel means "you can go here" (or, for the contact form, "you act here"). Directory rows and writing-list entries are panels because they are links. Non-interactive content (facts, rules, prose, lists) is never put in a panel; it sits on the ground in a block.

dos: Do open every page with a left-aligned display heading and one lead line.
Do keep SaveBytes blue to the logo and one action per screen.
Do use a tone-step panel only for something the visitor can go into or act in.
Do add a product or a post through its registry entry, never by building a new layout.
Do keep 44px touch targets and the 2px blue focus ring.
Do accept the slashed zero; the typeface has no other zero.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, blur or shadows, at rest or on hover.
Don't put a label, eyebrow or numbered label above a heading.
Don't build icon cards or rows of feature cards.
Don't put more than one picture on a page.
Don't put non-interactive content in a panel.
Don't alter, recolour or animate the logo.
